about_the_game:
Dive into the chaotic charm of Super Farming Boy with this original soundtrack, composed by Toni Leys. From high-octane combo harvesting tunes to the eerie calm of radioactive nights, each track captures the energy, whimsy, and mystery of life on the chaotic farm.

This soundtrack blends retro synths, quirky melodies, and lush ambient textures to reflect the game’s unique mix of cozy farming and fast-paced action. Whether you're watering crops, dodging ghouls, or battling volcanic vegetables, there's a track to keep your adrenaline pumping—or help you chill after the storm.

Perfect for farming, working, or just vibing.
